title: AION 2 Leveling Guide: Episode, Ascension & Level 45
description: Follow Episode quests, resolve Ascension gates and reach the first dungeon milestones without wasting rewards.
summary: Follow Episode quests, resolve Ascension gates and reach the first dungeon milestones without wasting rewards.
quickAnswer: The level cap is 45. Follow J → Episode; fill blocked Ascension gauges with nearby Regional quests and sealed dungeons, then use the quest teleport at 100%. Combine matching destinations and save optional Odyle cube claims for useful gear.
